@'
import urllib.request,json
models=['minishlab/potion-base-8M','minishlab/potion-retrieval-32M','minishlab/potion-multilingual-128M','sentence-transformers/static-similarity-mrl-multilingual-v1','sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2']
rows=[]
for model in models:
 d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('https://huggingface.co/api/models/'+model))
 card=d.get('cardData') or {}
 langs=card.get('language') or []
 rows.append({'id':model,'revision':d['sha'],'license':card.get('license'),'parameters':d.get('safetensors',{}).get('total'),'languageTags':langs,'source':'https://huggingface.co/'+model})
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
open('.dip-local/static-alternatives-metadata.json','w',encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
'@ | & '.\.dip-local\laya-env\Scripts\python.exe'
